cost: Geometry O(n²) depths, nonprojectivity O(n³) worst for n arcs and nested ancestry. Report adds parser costs for each width and ten class interventions. Space O(tokens+predictions+beam trees+report). Malformed head arrays can panic.
description: Dependency-tree error geometry, relation classes, PP attachment and parser diagnostic report.
forward: depths follows each head chain while nonzero and steps<=n, stores root distance (cycles yield n+1). nonprojective(d) checks intervening words for ancestry under h, root arcs false. report decodes baseline, geometry, PP, k-best oracle then constrained class interventions; absent constrained tree reuses baseline and counts dead.
inverse: R(depths)=all in-range head arrays with those truncated path lengths; star siblings and different same-depth parents collide. Relation class inverse is the finite set of Rel variants matched to that class; class does not reconstruct exact subtype.
limitations: No trained-parser/report execution; PP and constrained-beam branches source-derived
Comment cycle-at-n differs from actual n+1; model records code behavior
Reported nonprojective ceiling text is not a proved bound
state: Head arrays (1-based arcs, zero root), relation/tag vectors, prediction beams and report counters.
